features: Intel® Xeon® 6700-series processors with E-cores, Single Socket LGA-4710 (Socket E2) supported, CPU TDP supports Up to 350W TDP
Up to 2TB ECC RDIMM, DDR5-6400MT/s (1DPC) or DDR5-5200MT/s (2DPC) in 16 DIMM slots
1 PCIe 5.0 x8 and 3 PCIe 5.0 x16 HHHL
60 3.5"/2.5" Hot-swap SAS3/SATA3 drives, 2 2.5" Hot-swap Gen4 NVMe
Drive Controller support via Broadcom® 3916 or 3816

CPU: Intel® Xeon® 6700/6500 series processors with P-cores or 6700 series processors with E-cores
Note: Supports up to 350W TDP CPUs (Air Cooled)

Memory: Max Memory (1DPC): Up to 2TB 6400MT/s ECC DDR5 RDIMM
Max Memory (2DPC): Up to 2TB 5200MT/s ECC DDR5 RDIMM

LAN: 1 RJ45 1 GbE Dedicated BMC LAN port

Power configurations: Power-on mode for AC power recovery

Hardware: Silicon Root of Trust (RoT) – NIST 800-193 Compliant

PCI-Express (PCIe) Configuration: Default 1 PCIe 5.0 x8 (in x8) HHHL slot

Drive Bays Configuration: Default: Total 60 bays 60 top-loading hot-swap 3.5"/2.5" SAS/SATA drive bays
Option A: Total 4 bays 4 rear hot-swap 2.5" PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe* drive bays
Option B: Total 2 bays 2 internal fixed 2.5" PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe* drive bays
(*NVMe support may require additional storage controller and/or cables, please see the optional parts list for details)
